items.title: Public Comment (comments limited to three minutes per person; comments regarding items not on this agenda limited to statements of factual information/restatement of existing policy in response to an inquiry or proposal to place the subject on a future agenda)

Developer reports; annexation/utility commitments; related assignments/consents; status of the petition to the City of Houston for consent to annexation of the approximately 168.88-acre Westgreen Creek tract; defined area and financing agreement
Update on Harris County Precinct 4 “Places 4 People” grant application; drainage study and right-of-way acquisition appraisal proposals; related authorizations
Operator’s report; District facility security measures; sludge hauling services; consider and adopt amended Rate Order
Bookkeeper’s report; approval of disbursements; status of FYE 2026 audit
Status of NW 12 Joint WWTP Agreement (amended and restated)

Tax Report; hold Public Hearing on the proposed tax rate for the District; adopt Order Setting Tax Rate for the District (proposed total tax rate of $0.62 per $100 for the District); authorize related Truth-in-Taxation filings and District website postings under Section 26.18, Tax Code
Engineer’s report, contracts, and pay applications
District detention pond and drainage channel report

Executive Session pursuant to Section 551.071, Texas Government Code, for consultation with the District’s attorney regarding pending or contemplated litigation arising from the July 25, 2026 chlorine gas release; reconvene in open session and take action as necessary

Consider engagement of Friedman, Dazzio & Zulanas, P.C. as special litigation counsel on a contingent fee basis in connection with matters arising from the July 25, 2026 chlorine gas release at the District’s Water Plant No. 1; adopt Resolution making the findings required by Section 2254.1036, Texas Government Code; and authorize related actions, including submission of the contract to the Texas Attorney General under Section 2254.1038, Texas Government Code
